desc:
Guide The Soccer Legends!

How to Play:
🖌️Draw paths to bring the soccer players home safely!
🚨 Don't crash into other soccer legends to complete the puzzle.
💀 Avoid the The Ronaldo
⭐ Collect the stars

This game might sound easy, but it's puzzles can get a little tricky!

💾 Progress is saved, your levels save when you leave!
💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players

👍 If you love the game, make sure to like and favorite.
